mapper.select: SELECT workspace_snapshot FROM arte_ai_reservation WHERE attempt_key=#{attemptKey} AND invocation_key=#{invocationKey}

mapper.sql: FROM arte_ai_reservation r JOIN arte_ai_account a ON a.id_key=r.account_key JOIN arte_ai_invocation i ON i.id_key=r.invocation_key WHERE r.account_key=#{accountKey} AND a.owner_key=#{ownerKey} AND i.owner_key=#{ownerKey} AND (r.workspace_snapshot LIKE '%"state":"RESERVED"%' OR r.workspace_snapshot LIKE '%"state":"PENDING_RECONCILIATION"%') AND (i.workspace_snapshot LIKE '%"kind":"GENERATION"%' OR i.workspace_snapshot LIKE '%"kind":"TOOL"%') AND (i.workspace_snapshot LIKE '%"state":"UNKNOWN"%' OR i.workspace_snapshot LIKE '%"state":"SUCCEEDED"%' OR i.workspace_snapshot LIKE '%"state":"FAILED"%' OR i.workspace_snapshot LIKE '%"state":"CANCELLED"%' OR i.workspace_snapshot LIKE '%"state":"TIMED_OUT"%' OR i.workspace_snapshot LIKE '%"state":"INTERRUPTED"%')
mapper.select:
SELECT r.workspace_snapshot
ORDER BY r.id_key ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT workspace_snapshot FROM arte_ai_reservation WHERE id_key IN #{key}
